create_broadcasted_position_embedding: create a BroadcastedPositionEmbedding module with a given latent shape and embedding dimension for spatiotemporal embeddings
use_broadcasted_position_embedding_forwa: use the forward method of BroadcastedPositionEmbedding to get position embeddings from a batch of position IDs
inspect_broadcasted_position_embedding_i: inspect the indices property of BroadcastedPositionEmbedding to view the cartesian product of broadcasted position indices
create_sinusoidal_position_embeddings: create a SinusoidalPositionEmbeddings module with a configurable embedding dimension for encoding timesteps in diffusion models
use_sinusoidal_position_embeddings_forwa: use the forward method of SinusoidalPositionEmbeddings to encode input timesteps into sinusoidal waveform embeddings
